title: Policy bundle pointer latest.json (C7)
description: GET <bundle-url>/latest.json (served with ETag). Receivers poll every 30 s (overrides: 5 s). url and sigUrl are file names relative to the directory of latest.json (no host, no path, no '..'). Receivers MUST additionally check (CC-026): the revision inside url and sigUrl equals revision; after downloading, the signature verifies, and manifest.json inside the signed archive has revision equal to this revision and gitSha starting with its sha7 part; revision is strictly higher than the loaded one (equal or lower is rejected).

url.description: policies-<revision>.tar.gz in the same directory as latest.json.

sigUrl.description: policies-<revision>.tar.gz.sig in the same directory as latest.json.
